category: hosted debrid proxy and companion API for Stremio addons

free_tier.stated: Free and accountless: 'This is the public instance of StremThru, sponsored by ElfHosted. Reasonable rate limits apply so it stays fast for everyone.' Served version string 'StremThru v0.105.3'.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a request proxy, not a store

retention.stated: not applicable; the proxy holds no library

egress.terms: Not metered and no figure published. It proxies addon requests, so the bytes it forwards are metadata and link resolution, not video.

interface_detail: HTTP service titled 'Companion for Stremio'; it sits behind an addon (AIOStreams or Torrentio-style) and forwards store requests through one IP.
tooling: no install on the public instance; the client pastes the base URL into the addon that uses it. Self-hosting is possible but not needed, which is why it is here.
chaining: The piece that hides the client's IP from the debrid provider: one exit IP for every addon call, which is what avoids the multi-IP bans Real-Debrid applies to shared or rotating addresses.

limits.value: unpublished 'reasonable rate limits' on the shared public instance

limits_note: The page publishes no limit figure and no endpoint documentation in the rendered text; the service's API surface was not enumerated.
binding_note: It carries no bytes of its own, so the only thing that can fail first is the shared request rate on the sponsor's instance.

identity_cost.detail: No account to use the public instance. The debrid credentials it proxies are the client's own.

reliability_note: One sponsor, one instance: if ElfHosted retires it, the addon that depends on it loses its exit IP. Version drifted to v0.105.3, so the public instance tracks upstream closely.
confidence_note: The landing page was read (HTTP 200, 31 words, version string). No request was proxied through it - doing so needs a debrid key - so whether the rate limit bites at 1 TiB/month is unknown.

evidence.proved: HTTP 200: 'StremThru v0.105.3', 'Companion for Stremio', 'This is the public instance of StremThru, sponsored by ElfHosted ❤️. Reasonable rate limits apply so it stays fast for everyone.'
the paid pairing, USD 9.00 / month: 'Your own private AIOStreams addon with a StremThru instance alongside, so your streams reach every device through your own proxy'

notes: Cheapest working answer to the multi-IP problem found: the paid version is bundled only, never sold alone at a published price, so a client who needs a stable exit IP either buys the USD 9 bundle or accepts the shared instance's rate limit.
